cues.en: Instructor: Now I'm going to show you how to implement a multiple regression in code with and without an interaction term.
cues.zh: 講師：現在示範用程式碼實作多元迴歸，分成含交互作用項與不含兩種。

cues.en: This is going to be the same experiments that- or the same dataset that I described in the previous video.
cues.zh: 使用上一支影片描述的同一個實驗，或同一份資料。

cues.en: So that was about the combined effects of sleep and study hours on exam scores.
cues.zh: 研究睡眠與讀書時數，對考試成績的共同影響。

cues.en: So here's how I create all of the data.
cues.zh: 這是建立全部資料的方式。

cues.en: I'm not really gonna go through this in a lot of detail, so I will let you look through this if you like.
cues.zh: 不會詳細逐一說明，有興趣可以自己研究。

cues.en: But essentially, it's just, you know, some method that I came up with to generate the kind of data that I was looking for.
cues.zh: 基本上，只是我為了產生想要的資料，而想出的方法。

cues.en: So, you know, I was looking for this specific type of interaction, which I drew in that line plot in the previous video.
cues.zh: 想要的是上一支影片折線圖中，畫出的特定交互作用模式。

cues.en: So that's how I created the data.
cues.zh: 所以這樣建立資料。

cues.en: So here you see also an example of how I discretized the data.
cues.zh: 這裡也看到資料如何離散化。

cues.en: So I bin the data to be able to visualize all of the data, the multi-dimensional data, on one two dimensional graph.
cues.zh: 分箱，才能把多維資料全畫在一張二維圖上。

cues.en: So we have the data separated according to less than four hours studied, that's the black dots here, five to six hours studied, that's the red dots,
cues.zh: 依讀書時數分組：少於 4 小時，是黑點；5 到 6 小時，是紅點，

cues.en: and more than seven hours studied, and that's the blue triangles here.
cues.zh: 超過 7 小時，是這裡的藍色三角形。

cues.en: And exam score is our dependent variable, so that's on the Y-axis.
cues.zh: 考試分數是依變數，所以放 Y 軸。

cues.en: All right, so in MATLAB there's a couple of different ways to set up a multiple regression.
cues.zh: MATLAB 有幾種設定多元迴歸的方式。

cues.en: You can do it using basically the same format that I showed in the previous code video on simple regression.
cues.zh: 基本上可以用上一支簡單迴歸程式影片的相同格式。

cues.en: There I use the regress function.
cues.zh: 當時用 regress 函式。

cues.en: So here I create the design matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡建立設計矩陣。

cues.en: It is a column vector of ones.
cues.zh: 先有一個全為 1 的欄向量。

cues.en: It is- so that's the intercept.
cues.zh: 那是截距。

cues.en: And then we have sleep hours, hours studying.
cues.zh: 再有睡眠時數、讀書時數。

cues.en: And then here is the interaction term.
cues.zh: 這裡是交互作用項。

cues.en: And you can see it is literally the one variable multiplied by the other.
cues.zh: 可以看到，確實就是一個變數乘另一個。

cues.en: So the interaction term between sleep and hours studied is literally just sleep times hours studied.
cues.zh: 睡眠與讀書時數的交互作用，就是睡眠乘讀書時數。

cues.en: So let's see what our design matrix looks like.
cues.zh: 看看設計矩陣的樣子。

cues.en: You can see now it's four columns because we have four different parameters in the model, the intercept and the two regressors,
cues.zh: 現在有四欄，因為模型有四個不同參數：截距、兩個迴歸變數，

cues.en: the two main effect regressors, and then the interaction term.
cues.zh: 兩個主效應迴歸變數，再加交互作用項。

cues.en: Okay, and then we can use the regress function where we input the dependent variable and the design matrix.
cues.zh: 接著使用 regress，輸入依變數與設計矩陣。

cues.en: And yeah, like I mentioned, that's the same thing that we saw in the previous code video.
cues.zh: 與上一支程式影片相同。

cues.en: So now we get this stats vector here, which, as I mentioned before, is the R squared, the F ratio, the P value,
cues.zh: 得到 stats 向量，之前提過，是 R 平方、F 比值、P 值，

cues.en: and something about the error variance.
cues.zh: 以及誤差變異數的資訊。

cues.en: Now because MATLAB is actually printing this out in scientific notation, so it can be a little bit difficult to interpret that this is actually a pretty good R squared.
cues.zh: MATLAB 用科學記號印出，所以可能不容易看出，這其實是很好的 R 平方。

cues.en: So I'm gonna change the format.
cues.zh: 改一下格式。

cues.en: I sometimes like doing format bank.
cues.zh: 我有時喜歡用 format bank。

cues.en: This is for, like, formatting for numbers.
cues.zh: 是數字格式設定。

cues.en: So that basically just forces us to always have two numbers after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 基本上強制總是顯示小數點後兩位。

cues.en: So we see the R squared is really high, the F ratio for the entire model is ludicrously high, 1,100.
cues.zh: 可以看到，R 平方很高，整個模型的 F 比值高得誇張，是 1,100。

cues.en: It's really high.
cues.zh: 非常高。

cues.en: The P value is tiny, tiny, tiny.
cues.zh: P 值非常非常小。

cues.en: Now the reason why it's this high is because I simulated the data and I didn't add any noise.
cues.zh: 原因是模擬資料時，沒有加入任何雜訊。

cues.en: So I created the data to contain the pattern that I was looking for, and I didn't add any noise.
cues.zh: 我建立資料，包含想要的模式，但沒有加雜訊。

cues.en: If you like, if you're curious, you can try adding some noise to all of these data and see how that affects the statistics.
cues.zh: 有興趣可以替資料加一點雜訊，看看統計量如何變化。

cues.en: But what I wanna focus on more is evaluating these models and, in particular, using a different MATLAB function to help us create more complicated models.
cues.zh: 但更想聚焦於評估模型，尤其使用另一個 MATLAB 函式，建立更複雜的模型。

cues.en: If you have a relatively simple regression model, then the regress function is fine.
cues.zh: 迴歸模型比較簡單時，regress 就很好。

cues.en: So here I'm making a plot of the residuals.
cues.zh: 這裡畫殘差。

cues.en: This is a variable resid that is given as one of the outputs from the regress function.
cues.zh: resid 是 regress 的其中一個輸出。

cues.en: This is just the Epsilon term that I've been showing in the slide.
cues.zh: 就是投影片展示的 epsilon 項。

cues.en: So it's the data values minus the predicted data values.
cues.zh: 資料值減去預測資料值。

cues.en: And now what we should see is that these are randomly distributed around zero.
cues.zh: 預期它們應該隨機分布在 0 周圍。

cues.en: And here it doesn't really look like a really random distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來不太像隨機分布。

cues.en: It doesn't look much like a cloud.
cues.zh: 不太像一團點雲。

cues.en: But that's because, as I just mentioned, I simulated these data to be noise free.
cues.zh: 因為如剛才所說，模擬資料沒有雜訊。

cues.en: So the residuals are going to look a little bit unusual.
cues.zh: 所以殘差會有一點不尋常。

cues.en: Okay, so what I want to show you now is a different way of fitting these models using fitlm.
cues.zh: 現在示範用 fitlm 擬合模型的另一種方式。

cues.en: So fitlm, the lm is for linear model.
cues.zh: fitlm 的 lm 代表線性模型。

cues.en: This is MATLAB's general approach to fitting linear models.
cues.zh: 這是 MATLAB 擬合線性模型的一般方式。

cues.en: So it works for regression, it works for LMEs, or linear mixed effects models, it works for hierarchical linear models.
cues.zh: 適用於迴歸、LME，也就是線性混合效應模型，以及階層線性模型。

cues.en: Any kind of, you know, sort of rich, detailed, complicated linear model that you can come up with, MATLAB will fit with fitlm.
cues.zh: 任何你能想出的豐富、詳細、複雜線性模型，MATLAB 都能用 fitlm 擬合。

cues.en: So the main way that this function works is that we input the design matrix, and again, all the columns in the design matrix correspond to the variables, the predictors.
cues.zh: 主要方式，是輸入設計矩陣，其各欄對應變數、預測變數。

cues.en: I'm gonna undo this format bank.
cues.zh: 先取消 format bank。

cues.en: And then we have the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 接著是依變數。

cues.en: And then there's some optional inputs after that, so I'm inputting the variable names.
cues.zh: 後面有一些選用輸入，這裡輸入變數名稱。

cues.en: And this is the columns of the design matrix.
cues.zh: 對應設計矩陣各欄。

cues.en: So we have the intercept, the amount of sleep, study hours, and the interaction.
cues.zh: 截距、睡眠量、讀書時數，以及交互作用。

cues.en: And then we have the exam scores, which is the dependent variable over here.
cues.zh: 接著是這裡的依變數，考試分數。

cues.en: Okay, so we can run this, and I'm gonna clear the screen here.
cues.zh: 執行，再清除螢幕。

cues.en: And when we run this, the output of this fitlm function is actually giving us a lot of information.
cues.zh: fitlm 的輸出其實提供很多資訊。

cues.en: So we can print this all out.
cues.zh: 可以全部印出來。

cues.en: So we can see the model.
cues.zh: 可以看到模型。

cues.en: Now, it tells us that it's modeling the exam scores as a function of one plus the intercept and sleep and hours and interaction.
cues.zh: 它說考試分數，被建模為 1 加截距、睡眠、時數與交互作用的函數。

cues.en: Now this is actually really weird.
cues.zh: 這其實很奇怪。

cues.en: What is that one doing here?
cues.zh: 這個 1 在做什麼？

cues.en: Well, it turns out that fitlm function will insert an intercept into your models unless you explicitly tell it not to include an intercept.
cues.zh: fitlm 會自動替模型加入截距，除非明確要求不加入。

cues.en: So in fact, what we really should have done here was include an extra parameter that tells fitlm not to include the intercept,
cues.zh: 所以其實應該額外加入參數，告訴 fitlm 不要納入截距，

cues.en: because we already have that in the design matrix.
cues.zh: 因為設計矩陣已經有了。

cues.en: And you can see here with this regression table that we get this implicit intercept added to the model and the estimate is zero.
cues.zh: 迴歸表可以看到，模型多了一個隱含截距，估計值為 0。

cues.en: And the reason why the estimate is zero is because we already have our own intercept in the model.
cues.zh: 估計值為 0，是因為模型已經有自己的截距。

cues.en: So it's a little bit awkward.
cues.zh: 有點尷尬。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do here is run this again without the intercept term.
cues.zh: 現在去掉截距項，再執行一次。

cues.en: So I'm just using the design matrix from columns two to the end.
cues.zh: 只用設計矩陣第二欄到最後一欄。

cues.en: So I'm not including the first column.
cues.zh: 不包含第一欄。

cues.en: But then it's pretty interesting to see that.
cues.zh: 接著看到很有意思的結果。

cues.en: So here's the output of this lm two.
cues.zh: 這是 lm2 的輸出。

cues.en: Now it's interesting to see that it added the intercept, but if we look at all of these four coefficients, so 82, -3, -7, 1,
cues.zh: 它加上截距，再看四個係數，82、負 3、負 7、1，
這裡也是 82、負 3、負 7、1。

cues.en: So in fact these- the results are the same.
cues.zh: 所以結果相同。

cues.en: And you can also check all the values are the same between these two models.
cues.zh: 也能檢查兩個模型的全部數值都相同。

cues.en: So it's actually not such a big deal if you include or exclude this intercept term.
cues.zh: 所以是否納入這個截距項，其實影響不大。

cues.en: However, it is pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 但還是很有意思。

cues.en: So I didn't actually show you this yet, but when I ran this line of code, fitlm, MATLAB gave me this warning message.
cues.zh: 還沒展示，剛才執行 fitlm 那行程式碼時，MATLAB 給了警告。

cues.en: It said, "Regression design matrix is rank deficient."
cues.zh: 它說：「迴歸設計矩陣秩不足。」

cues.en: And remember when I talked about setting up the design matrix in order to make sure that the least square solution to the general linear model
cues.zh: 記得，討論如何設定設計矩陣，讓一般線性模型的最小平方解

cues.en: is a valid one, I mentioned this term.
cues.zh: 有效時，提過一個術語。

cues.en: It was a long term, and I've already asked you to reproduce this, so I hope you remember it now.
cues.zh: 是個長詞，之前已經問過，希望你現在記得。

cues.en: It is...
cues.zh: 就是……

cues.en: You remember it?
cues.zh: 記得嗎？

cues.en: It was multicollinearity, and multicollinearity happens when you have repetitions in the design matrix, and that leads to a reduced rank design matrix.
cues.zh: 多重共線性，設計矩陣有重複項時，就會造成多重共線性，導致設計矩陣降秩。

cues.en: If you're not really familiar with the term rank, it doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 不熟悉秩這個詞，也沒關係。

cues.en: But basically in this context, the rank refers to the number of independent variables that are actually independent of each other.
cues.zh: 基本上，在這裡指真正彼此獨立的自變數數量。

cues.en: So in fact, by adding an intercept and having MATLAB include its own intercept, we had two intercepts in the model.
cues.zh: 我們自己加截距，MATLAB 又加一次，因此模型有兩個截距。

cues.en: So these two terms in the model were causing multicollinearity, and MATLAB is giving us a problem or a warning message saying it had a problem with the fitting.
cues.zh: 這兩項造成多重共線性，MATLAB 因而警告擬合有問題。

cues.en: Now in this particular case, it worked out fine.
cues.zh: 這個特定例子，最後還是正常。

cues.en: We still got a good fit to the data.
cues.zh: 仍然很好地擬合資料。

cues.en: But that's because the model was relatively simple, and the data are relatively straightforward and noise free.
cues.zh: 因為模型比較簡單，資料比較直接，而且沒有雜訊。

cues.en: So if you see a warning like this when you're really running regression models, then you have to inspect this further.
cues.zh: 實際做迴歸時，看到這類警告，必須進一步檢查。

cues.en: You have to figure out what is going on, why is there a rank deficiency, why is there multicollinearity?
cues.zh: 要查出為什麼秩不足、為什麼有多重共線性。

cues.en: Okay, enough of that.
cues.zh: 這先談到這裡。

cues.en: What I want to show now is basically just a couple of other options just to give you a little bit more familiarity with how to use this fitlm function.
cues.zh: 接著示範其他幾個選項，讓你更熟悉 fitlm 的使用。

cues.en: So here I'm excluding the interaction term, and in this case that's pretty simple.
cues.zh: 這裡排除交互作用項，這種情況很簡單。

cues.en: I'm saying the design matrix, and I'm only taking the second and third columns.
cues.zh: 只取設計矩陣的第二與第三欄。

cues.en: So that's just excluding the first column for the intercept.
cues.zh: 排除第一欄截距。

cues.en: And I'm excluding the fourth column, which is where I had the interaction term.
cues.zh: 也排除第四欄，原本的交互作用項。

cues.en: So let's look at this.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: And I just want to quickly point out that the total R squared here is 0.75, which is actually pretty good.
cues.zh: 總 R 平方是 0.75，其實很不錯。

cues.en: I mean, this basically means that our model is accounting for 75% of the variance of the data.
cues.zh: 基本上表示模型解釋 75% 的資料變異。

cues.en: However, when we compare that to the R squared of the previous model that included the interaction term, the R squared was 0.99.
cues.zh: 但前一個包含交互作用的模型，R 平方是 0.99。

cues.en: So, you know, basically the model accounts for nearly all of the variance in the data with the interaction term.
cues.zh: 含交互作用項，模型幾乎能解釋全部資料變異。

cues.en: Without the interaction term, we actually get a much poorer fit to the data overall.
cues.zh: 沒有交互作用，整體擬合其實差很多。

cues.en: Okay, and then there's one more thing I want to show you about using fitlm, and that is how to specify an interaction term
cues.zh: 還想示範 fitlm 的一件事：如何指定交互作用項，

cues.en: without it being in the design matrix.
cues.zh: 但不事先放進設計矩陣。

cues.en: So here I have the design matrix again without the interaction term in here.
cues.zh: 這裡設計矩陣又沒有交互作用項。

cues.en: So this is only the main two independent variables, the amount of sleep, and the amount of study, and then the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 只有兩個主要自變數，睡眠量與讀書量，另外有依變數。

cues.en: And now here I'm actually specifying the entire model.
cues.zh: 現在直接指定整個模型。

cues.en: So I'm specifying that the exam scores, and MATLAB knows what variables these correspond to because of this input here.
cues.zh: 指定考試分數的模型，MATLAB 因為這個輸入，知道對應哪些變數。

cues.en: So the exam scores are modeled as sleep*study.
cues.zh: 考試分數建模為 sleep*study。

cues.en: Now when you write sleep*study like this, MATLAB will break this up into
cues.zh: 這樣寫時，MATLAB 會展開成

cues.en: sleep + study + the interaction between sleep and study.
cues.zh: sleep 加 study，再加 sleep 與 study 的交互作用。

cues.en: So if you just write sleep*study, MATLAB will automatically expand this to include the main effects plus the interaction term.
cues.zh: 只寫 sleep*study，就會自動展開成主效應與交互作用。

cues.en: So just like this.
cues.zh: 就像這樣。

cues.en: And then- so then we can look at the output here.
cues.zh: 再看輸出。

cues.en: And you can see we get the R squared going back up to 0.99, and we see this interaction term here in the regression table.
cues.zh: R 平方回到 0.99，迴歸表中也看到交互作用項。

cues.en: Okay, so that just gives you a few different options for using fitlm.
cues.zh: 這就是 fitlm 的幾種用法。

cues.en: And then the last thing is it's generally a good idea to look at the correlation matrix of the design matrix.
cues.zh: 最後，查看設計矩陣的相關矩陣，一般是好習慣。

cues.en: So here I'm inputting the design matrix, excluding the intercept and just looking at the real variables.
cues.zh: 這裡輸入設計矩陣，排除截距，只看真正變數。

cues.en: And I'm computing those, the correlation matrix between those.
cues.zh: 計算它們之間的相關矩陣。

cues.en: And what you can see here is that the correlation between the number of study hours and the interaction between sleep and study hours is really strongly correlated.
cues.zh: 可以看到，讀書時數與睡眠乘讀書時數的交互作用，相關非常強。

cues.en: They're correlated at 0.94.
Now again, I created these data and I created them to be noiseless.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，資料是我建立的，而且沒有雜訊。

cues.en: So in this particular case, it's not a big deal.
cues.zh: 這個例子沒什麼大問題。

cues.en: But if I am running an actual regression model with real data and I see that the design matrix has correlations of 0.94, that's going to make me concerned.
cues.zh: 但實際資料的迴歸模型，如果看到設計矩陣有 0.94 的相關，我會擔心。

cues.en: I'm going to probably want to inspect this and figure out if there's a mistake that made these two independent variables be so similar to each other.
cues.zh: 大概會進一步檢查，看看是否有錯誤，讓這兩個自變數如此相似。

cues.en: So to run the linear regression here in Python, I'm going to be using something from scikit-learn, and it's the linear module- linear regression function
cues.zh: Python 的線性迴歸，我要使用 scikit-learn 裡的線性模組、LinearRegression 函式，

cues.en: from scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 來自 scikit-learn。

cues.en: Okay, so here is where I create these data.
cues.zh: 這裡建立資料。

cues.en: Now, it's a little bit of a kind of weird way to create the data that I just sort of developed.
cues.zh: 這是自己想出來、有點奇怪的建立方法。

cues.en: And let me just show you what the data looked like.
cues.zh: 先展示資料的樣子。

cues.en: So this is the actual data that I drew that simplified line diagram from in the previous video.
cues.zh: 上一支影片那張簡化折線圖，就是根據這份實際資料畫的。

cues.en: So here we see the number of hours slept, and on the Y-axis is our dependent variable, which is the exam score.
cues.zh: 這裡是睡眠時數，Y 軸是依變數，考試分數。

cues.en: And then I have this broken up into these three different groups according to the number of hours studied.
cues.zh: 再依讀書時數，分成三個不同群組。

cues.zh: 接著使用……

So the model basically accounts for 99% of the variance in the signal, in the dependent variable.
